_comment: DOCX FURNITURE strings for the dashboard DOCX path (generate-cti-docx-hybrid.py / generate-cti-docx.py via cti_docx_postprocess / cti_docx_styles / cti_docx_toc): the cover title and metadata labels, the running header and footer, the table-of-contents title and the appendix section headings the generator itself adds. Selected with `--lang <code>` (default en). The BODY — the analyst's narrative from the Markdown — is never translated here. Every key should exist in every language; a missing one falls back to English rather than printing an empty label. Strings are stored as precomposed (NFC) Unicode so Vietnamese diacritics render correctly in Arial/Georgia. Generic vocabulary only — never case data (RULE 1).
